title: Maintainer validates every registered schema contract generically
summary: Canonical and contract schemas have collision-free registered identities and are reachable through one real fail-closed generic validation route.
preconditions: The canonical schema directories and contract schema directories are present

steps.action: Enumerate canonical and contract schemas into one registry
steps.expected_outcome: Each schema has exactly one stable collision-free identity

steps.action: Validate conforming and nonconforming instances through the advertised generic route
steps.expected_outcome: Valid instances pass and invalid, unknown, or colliding identities fail closed

postconditions: The advertised generic contract-validation surface is executable and fail-closed

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every canonical and contract schema has one collision-free registered identity.
The generic validation route accepts valid instances and rejects invalid, unknown, or ambiguous schema identities.
